title: CaCTüS — Computation and Cognition Tübingen Summer Internship
institution: Max Planck Institute for Biological Cybernetics (CaCTüS programme)
about: Paid three-month summer research internship in computation and cognition in Tübingen, 1 July to 30 September 2027. The key-dates table lists the portal opening on 21 October 2026, the deadline on 16 November 2026, and interviews in January 2027.
requirements: Available for the full 90 days between 1 July and 30 September 2027
Applicants for Projects 1-4 must be enrolled at an academic institution from January to October 2027
Internship must be voluntary (no course-credit internships)
Apply only through the official CaCTüS portal; do not contact supervisors or send applications by email

upskill.name: Machine Learning & Predictive Modelling I
why: "Machine learning" (listed skill) → "Build supervised learning models for regression and classification using methods such as support vector machines, random forests, and gradient boosting."
"Computational neuroscience" (listed skill) → "Apply unsupervised learning techniques, including clustering and dimensionality reduction, to discover structure in data without predefined labels."
